blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark-theme dashboard with a consistent #4477AA monochromatic palette (not default colors), clean grid layout, quiet uppercase panel labels, and a genuinely clever color-usage scatter that plots actual hex values in HCL space — held back from 8 by 9px node labels that strain at rendered size and a block list whose thumbnail placeholders render as uniform grey boxes, flattening the bottom panel.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Excellent encoding integrity: scaleSqrt used for both network and color dot radii, timeline bar chart has zero baseline with data-driven domain via d3.max, monthly bins are data-driven via d3.utcMonth.range, HCL axes use semantically correct fixed domains [0,360]/[0,100], and the timeline Y scale is intentionally anchored to full-dataset max so filtered overlays compare honestly against the background.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces brush/click redraws; no transitions means no mid-flight snap; no feedback loops; only gap is the absence of a resize handler, leaving x/y scales stale if the viewport changes.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: 4-view crossfilter with pre-computed (non-reheating) force layout is well within working memory limits; the color scatter is intentionally dense but readable as a distribution, though tracking simultaneous brush changes across all 4 panels takes moderate effort.
